+++ b/gitseed/cli/test_table.py
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+import pytest
+from gitseed.cli.table import Row, table, json_rows
+
+
+class TestTable:
+    def test_table_shows_only_ready_for_review(self):
+        rows = [
+            Row(repo="repo_a", score=95, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="repo_b", score=None, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="repo_c", score=85, withheld="license"),
+            Row(repo="repo_d", score=75, withheld=None),
+        ]
+        result = table(rows)
+        lines = result.split("\n")
+
+        assert lines[0] == "repo  score"
+        assert "repo_a" in result and "95" in result
+        assert "repo_d" in result and "75" in result
+        assert "repo_b" not in result
+        assert "repo_c" not in result
+
+    def test_table_filters_out_no_score(self):
+        rows = [
+            Row(repo="graded", score=50, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="ungraded", score=None, withheld=None),
+        ]
+        result = table(rows)
+        assert "graded" in result
+        assert "ungraded" not in result
+
+    def test_table_filters_out_withheld(self):
+        rows = [
+            Row(repo="ok", score=60, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="blocked", score=60, withheld="privacy"),
+        ]
+        result = table(rows)
+        assert "ok" in result
+        assert "blocked" not in result
+
+    def test_table_empty_when_no_ready_repos(self):
+        rows = [
+            Row(repo="repo_a", score=None, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="repo_b", score=50, withheld="legal"),
+        ]
+        result = table(rows)
+        lines = result.split("\n")
+        assert len(lines) == 1
+        assert lines[0] == "repo  score"
+
+    def test_table_with_empty_input(self):
+        result = table([])
+        assert result == "repo  score"
+
+
+class TestJsonRows:
+    def test_json_rows_includes_all_rows_unfiltered(self):
+        rows = [
+            Row(repo="repo_a", score=95, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="repo_b", score=None, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="repo_c", score=85, withheld="license"),
+        ]
+        result = json_rows(rows)
+
+        assert len(result) == 3
+        assert result[0] == {"repo": "repo_a", "score": 95, "withheld": None}
+        assert result[1] == {"repo": "repo_b", "score": None, "withheld": None}
+        assert result[2] == {"repo": "repo_c", "score": 85, "withheld": "license"}
+
+    def test_json_rows_preserves_all_data(self):
+        rows = [
+            Row(repo="no_score", score=None, withheld=None),
+            Row(repo="withheld_reason", score=50, withheld="compliance"),
+        ]
+        result = json_rows(rows)
+
+        assert len(result) == 2
+        assert any(r["repo"] == "no_score" for r in result)
+        assert any(r["repo"] == "withheld_reason" for r in result)
+
+    def test_json_rows_with_empty_input(self):
+        result = json_rows([])
+        assert result == []
+
+    def test_json_rows_structure(self):
+        rows = [Row(repo="test", score=42, withheld="reason")]
+        result = json_rows(rows)
+
+        assert len(result) == 1
+        assert set(result[0].keys()) == {"repo", "score", "withheld"}
